behaviour.description: A 2-layer attention-only transformer: no MLPs, no LayerNorm, no biases, one head per layer, no attention mask (every position attends to every position). Vocabulary 6 tokens, sequences of 6 tokens, residual width 8. Each input is a function f on {0..5}: token i is f(i). Output class c stands for 'the longest cycle of f has length c + 1' (follow i -> f(i) -> f(f(i)) ... until it returns).
behaviour.reference_rule: length of the longest cycle of the input function, minus 1

sites.name: embed
sites.description: token + position embeddings, all 6 positions (index = position * 8 + dimension)

sites.name: attn0.out
sites.description: what layer 0's attention adds to the residual stream, all positions

sites.name: resid0.mid
sites.description: residual stream after layer 0's attention, all positions

sites.name: attn1.out
sites.description: what layer 1's attention adds to the residual stream, all positions

sites.name: resid1.mid
sites.description: residual stream after layer 1's attention, all positions
